notes: Phase 3.3 Operation Coordinator + Phase 3.4 Recovery Foundation. Adds an atomic cross-process operation lock for Repair, Auto Repair, Advanced Diagnostics, Updater and Setup; pauses Auto Repair during other operations; clears stale crash markers safely; prevents overlapping work; and fixes the stage rail so blue only advances when that stage is actually reached. Existing repair, Guardian, updater, diagnostics, tray and connection-intelligence features are preserved.
